arguments.command:
cd /workspace && sed -i "s|lines=\['PLAN 1 %d %d %d %d %d %d %d'%(C,hit,miss,dec\[0\],dec\[1\],dec\[2\])\]|lines=['PLAN 1 %d %d %d %d %d %d %d'%(C,hit,miss,dec[0],dec[1],dec[2])]|" /tmp/dbgdp2.py && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='/tmp/dbgdp2.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("lines=['PLAN 1 %d %d %d %d %d %d %d'%(C,hit,miss,dec[0],dec[1],dec[2])]",
            "lines=['PLAN 1 ' + ' '.join(map(str,[C,hit,miss,dec[0],dec[1],dec[2]]))]")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 /tmp/dbgdp2.py 2>&1 | head -30
